idea-plugin.name: splitrs (Rust refactoring assistant)
idea-plugin.description:
Integrates splitrs into IntelliJ IDEA via the built-in LSP client.

Provides:

  • Diagnostics when a Rust file exceeds your .splitrs.toml max_lines limit
  • A Refactor with splitrs code action to split large files in-editor
  • Hover showing file metrics (lines of code, method count, avg complexity)

Prerequisites: splitrs-lsp must be on your $PATH (cargo install splitrs). Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 or later.
